performance_claim_review: All 34 retained performance/identity/cost/limitation fields are exactly unchanged from the independently checked draft aadd10e4. They retain eight pooled query cells, 32 paired round cells, four ingestion cells and 16 ingestion pairs, 38 resource comparisons, storage snapshots, both prior attempts and all three negative p50/p95 observations.
Baseline is native v0.8.1, not Python fallback; original v0.8/v0.8.1 improvements are not added to these results.

The accepted fields bind exact final candidate 4390, 31 source/build inputs, runtime hash 6ec51 and frozen evaluator cfdb. No statistical-significance, all-input, all-platform-performance or universal-optimality claim is introduced.
Startup, memory and native-binary-size costs remain explicit. The complete artifact audit established equivalence only for recorded workloads.

prepublication_delivery.limitations: This agent reviewed the colleague's full RAM asset/source/log audit and compared exact resulting records; it did not redownload or reexecute the completed preparation. Counts are executions across environments, not 4320 distinct methods. Three interrupted matrices are retained and none are mixed into the successful run.
